name: Boston Initials 1889
description: Decorative spiral, leafy and geometric initials and their printing components from the Boston specimen of 1889.
observed: Individually catalogued historical impressions from the 1889 Boston specimen; see each icon and source/inventory.json for subjects, pages, specimen numbers, crop evidence and review status.
reconstructed: No new pictorial content. Thresholding, documented crop cleanup, cubic curve fitting and font-unit rounding interpret the scanned impressions. Names, search tags, Private Use assignments, scale and bearings are new project work. Paper, catalogue numbers and prices are excluded. Multi-tone companions separate observed ink strengths into three disjoint vector regions at default opacities 1, 0.55 and 0.25; these are modern interpretations, not evidence of separately printed inks.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), printed p. 237; PDF page 243, Internet Archive leaf 243
sources.rights: 1889 US publication; public domain in the United States under the maximum 95-year term. No modern redraw was used.
